interpretation: Upper-bound sensitivity, not a relabelling. It assumes that none of the records without a Premium or payment word belongs in billing/support and adds them to no other area. Many of them plainly describe free-tier limits without naming Premium (skip limits, forced shuffle, no repeat or rewind), and non-English payment words (for example 'paisa') are not matched, so the real effect is smaller than shown.
method: case-insensitive regular expression over review_text (the words listed); severity from the saved labels; area sums over all complaint and cancellation records (equal to area_rollup.json).
population: completed complaint and cancellation records of billing.premium_only (its membership in membership.csv), one per record, so row-weighted like the baseline ranking
word_notes: Case-insensitive. 'subscri-' matches subscribe, subscription and subscriber; 'paymen-', 'pric-', 'upgrad-' and 'purchas-' match payment(s), price/pricing, upgrade and purchase; 'charg-' matches at a word start (charge, charged); pay/paid/paying, free (free version, free tier, free user), buy, cost/costs, fee/fees and plan/plans match whole words only; premium, money, trial and $ match anywhere in the text.
